newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia unemployment falls to 2.6 pct - Negara.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia unemployment falls to 2.6 pct - Negara.

text.p: Unemployment in Malaysia fell to 2.6 percent in 1996, marking the fifth consecutive year that the economy operated at full employment, Malaysia's central bank said on Friday in its 1996 annual report.
"Total employment increased at an estimated rate of 3.3 percent... to 8.2 million in 1996, while the labour force grew... to 8.4 million," Bank Negara said.
A total of 725,200 legal foreign workers were registerd in Malaysia in 1996 to alleviate the tight labour market, it said.
The bulk of the foreign workforce was employed in the plantation, contruction, domestic services and manufacturing sectors, said Bank Negara.
